verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is explicitly API-first (docs and community both confirm the API covers card creation, cardholders, controls, disputes, funding, digital wallets, replacements, and even real-time authorization webhooks), and community commenters note that the Dashboard is comparatively thin compared to competitors like Emburse, suggesting the API is actually the primary surface rather than a secondary one. However, some UI-only elements like physical card design/appearance configuration and guided Dashboard workflows for disputes are described as dashboard-first experiences without confirmation that 100% of that configurability is exposed identically via API, and there's no independent audit confirming full UI/API parity. missing for 10: independent verification of full UI/API parity, confirmation that all dashboard-only settings (e.g., card appearance customization) are fully API-configurable, hands-on test evidence rather than only docs claims.
